paper_title: Search for dark matter particle interactions with electron final states with DarkSide-50
notes: DarkSide-50 sets 90% C.L. limits on axioelectric coupling g_Ae from ALP absorption for masses 0.03-0.2 keV/c2 (30-200 eV), among other couplings (dark-matter-electron cross section, dark photon kappa, sterile neutrino |Ue4|^2). The g_Ae exclusion (AxionElectron) is presented only in Fig. 2 with no numerical table or explicit values in the text, so no reliable (mass, coupling) data points can be extracted.
